name: Louder Suppressors
teaser: Hear suppressed gunshots from much further away! No more fantasy suppressors.
description_html:
Works on any version of SPT or EFT.

The change is purely cosmetic, makes no difference to AI.

To Install: Just drag and drop the contents of the included zip into where you installed SPT. If installed correctly, you should see the mod in the Bepinex/Plugins folder

Default distance you can hear suppressed gunshots is around 100-120 meters in vanilla. With this you can set it up to 400 meters. Default is 225 meters.
Will need to test more to see if there are any adjustments to the different sound clips that play at certain ranges, let me know if you find any guns that sound strange.

I have a Patreon if you want to support my work. I am unemployed and a student, but I am working on modding 8-12 hours a day, every day. Every dollar helps!
